clip: Card acceptance and payments, Mexico City (the company's 2024 release). 'The previous investors in Clip include General Atlantic LLC, Goldman Sachs Group Inc., Ribbit Capital, Alta Ventures ...' (Nearshore Americas, 2021-06-15, on the $250M Series D), and Ribbit's earliest deal vehicle in Clip is CL-C Ribbit Opportunity IV (Form D, 2020 Q1, coded to the Series C), followed by CL-D in the Series D. No earlier Ribbit round was found and the firm first listed Clip in 2022: the entry reads Growth.
dcg: Digital Currency Group, Grayscale's parent (Stamford, Connecticut). Ribbit bought in through the $700 million 2021 secondary: 'SoftBank led the round, with participation from Alphabet's CapitalG and Ribbit Capital', valuing DCG at $10B (CNBC, 2021-11-01), via its DG-S Bullfrog Opportunity II vehicle ($140.8M sold, Form D 2021 Q3): a secondary entry, Growth. The $10B stands as the last priced event, stale, aligned with the Bain Capital Ventures row. Genesis, DCG's lending unit, filed for bankruptcy in January 2023; DCG itself did not, so the row reads private.
kavak: Used-car marketplace and auto financing (Mexico City, Wikipedia). Ribbit co-led the $485M Series D of April 2021 at a $4B valuation: 'The round was led by D1 Capital Partners, Founders Fund, Ribbit and BOND' (LatamList), and joined the $700M Series E of September 2021 led by General Catalyst (Bloomberg Linea; its KV-E Bullfrog Opportunity I vehicle, Form D 2021 Q3). No earlier round names Ribbit. The $8.7B Series E mark is superseded by documented collapse evidence: Kavak raised $127M in March 2025 at a $2.2B valuation, led by SoftBank and General Atlantic (Contxto).
antora-energy: Thermal battery maker, San Jose (Pulse 2.0; Crunchbase News). Ribbit is named among the new investors in the $550M Series C of July 2026, co-led by G2 Venture Partners and Eclipse (Pulse 2.0, 2026-08-02), its entry. The company did not disclose the valuation (Crunchbase News, 2026-07-30), and without a citable priced figure no band from $1B up may be asserted (Rule A): the web check of 2026-09-28 found none, so the row reads below_1b with the check recorded, the round size pointing higher.
morse-money: Stablecoin-based global payments app (Sling Money, now Morse Money: sling.money redirects to morsemoney.com) of Avian Labs, founded in 2022 by Mike Hudack and Simon Amor (ex-Monzo), London. 'Sling Money said it previously raised $5 million in a seed round led by Ribbit Capital' and the $15M Series A 'was led by Union Square Ventures, Ribbit Capital, and Slow Ventures' (The Block, 2024-08-14), so the seed graduated on a named Series A. No source dates the seed; the entry year 2022 is the UK register's: Avian Labs Ltd came under its US parent Avian Labs Inc on 2022-07-13 and adopted new articles on 2022-07-28 (Companies House 13941760), the paperwork of a closing, and the company was incorporated only in February 2022.

robinhood: Commission-free brokerage (Menlo Park since 2018, Wikipedia). coinbase: Crypto exchange. Ribbit joined the $5M round of May 2013 led by Union Square Ventures (Global Venturing: USV 'led the round, and was joined by Ribbit Capital'), which Wikipedia names the Series A; it then joined the $25M round of December 2013 with Andreessen Horowitz and USV (Wikipedia) and, through its CB and CB-D vehicles, the 2015 Series C and the 2017 Series D. Ribbit held more than 5% before the listing (the 2020 DRS). Public since the April 2021 direct listing (NASDAQ: COIN); Remote-first since 2020, with a San Francisco office as its physical headquarters from 2025 (Wikipedia). nubank: Digital bank, São Paulo (Wikipedia). affirm: Buy now, pay later lender (San Francisco). Ribbit's first documented round is Affirm's April 2019 Series F: its AF-F Ribbit Opportunity III vehicle (Form D, 2019Q2) and Ribbit Capital III both signed the amended investors' rights agreement filed with the S-1 (exhibit 4.2, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1820953/000110465920126927/tm2026663d5_ex4-2.htm). Ribbit Capital III is a 2015 fund, so any earlier fund cheque falls in 2015 or later, when Affirm was past its Series A; the entry is Growth either way. Public since January 2021 (NASDAQ: AFRM); Market cap $22.68B on 2026-09-28 (StockAnalysis).
root: Car insurance (Root, Inc., Columbus, Ohio: Wikipedia). figure: Blockchain-based lender (HELOCs on the Provenance chain).
